admin_settings_app_default_list_type_des: The default type when creating new lists
admin_settings_app_time_zone_description: Sets when each day starts for birthdays, holidays, reminders, and auto-archive. Schedule the daily jobs to run after midnight in this time zone.
admin_settings_app_default_locale_descri: Used for people who have not chosen a language and whose browser asks for none of the ones offered, and for emails to them.
admin_settings_app_default_currency_desc: Used for purchase totals and for item prices that were saved without a currency. Changing it relabels those amounts; it does not convert them.
admin_settings_app_mobile_app_descriptio: Let users issue per-device API keys from their settings. Powers the iOS companion app.
admin_settings_app_mcp_description: Let users connect AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT) to their account through OAuth. Turns on the MCP endpoint, the consent page, Admin → MCP, and Settings → Connected Apps. Turning it off disconnects every assistant immediately.
admin_settings_app_christmas_lists_descr: Allow users to create Christmas-themed lists
admin_settings_app_christmas_archive_des: Days after Dec 25 to automatically archive claimed items on Christmas lists
admin_settings_app_christmas_emails_desc: Email owners who gave them what when Christmas gifts are revealed
admin_settings_app_christmas_reminder_em: Email every user N days before Christmas so they can spruce up their list
admin_settings_app_christmas_reminder_le: Days before Dec 25 to send the pre-Christmas reminder email
admin_settings_app_holiday_lists_descrip: Allow users to create lists for occasions like Easter, Mother's Day, Halloween, Diwali, etc. Christmas remains a separate list type above.
admin_settings_app_holiday_archive_descr: How many days after a holiday ends to automatically archive claimed items on holiday lists. For multi-day holidays, this counts from the last day.
admin_settings_app_max_archive_defer_des: How many days past a list's event date an editor, guardian, or partner can push back the automatic archive and reveal. This also limits the dates offered in the extension picker.
admin_settings_app_holiday_emails_descri: Email owners who gave them what when gifts on a holiday list are revealed
admin_settings_app_holiday_reminder_emai: Email every user N days before each custom holiday so they can make a list
admin_settings_app_holiday_reminder_lead: Days before a holiday to broadcast the pre-holiday reminder
admin_settings_app_birthday_lists_descri: Allow users to create birthday lists
admin_settings_app_birthday_archive_desc: Days after a birthday to reveal claimed gifts on birthday lists and wishlists, and send the gift summary email
admin_settings_app_birthday_emails_descr: Send day-of birthday greetings, and email who gave what when birthday gifts are revealed
admin_settings_app_birthday_reminder_ema: Email each user N days before their birthday so they can spruce up their list
admin_settings_app_birthday_reminder_lea: Days before a birthday to send the pre-birthday reminder email
admin_settings_app_reminder_emails_descr: Email the reminder on the day set by the lead time
admin_settings_app_mothers_day_descripti: Reminders, plus the option to mark people you shop for as a mother
admin_settings_app_mothers_day_lead_desc: Days before Mother's Day to send the reminder
admin_settings_app_fathers_day_descripti: Reminders, plus the option to mark people you shop for as a father
admin_settings_app_fathers_day_lead_desc: Days before Father's Day to send the reminder
admin_settings_app_valentines_day_descri: Reminders for users with a partner, sent before Valentine's Day in the country above
admin_settings_app_valentines_day_lead_d: Days before Valentine's Day to send the reminder
admin_settings_app_anniversary_descripti: Reminders, plus the anniversary date field on profiles. Both partners get the email. Turning this off hides the field.
admin_settings_app_anniversary_lead_desc: Days before Partner Anniversary to send the reminder
admin_settings_app_reminders_country_des: Used to work out the dates for Mother's Day, Father's Day, and Valentine's Day, which vary by country. Defaults to US.
admin_settings_app_reminder_picks_descri: Add up to three things still open on the person’s lists to each reminder above. Picked by priority, with no AI. Only the person the reminder is addressed to sees them.
admin_settings_app_todo_lists_descriptio: Allow users to create todo lists
admin_settings_app_comments_description: Allow users to post comments on items
admin_settings_app_comment_emails_descri: Email the list owner when someone comments on one of their items
admin_settings_email_gift_exchange_descr: Email people when their assignment is ready (an admin presses Send Emails) and when it changes. The emails never say who anyone has.
admin_settings_app_sign_ups_description: Let anyone who can reach this site create an account. Turn this off to add people yourself from Admin → Users. OIDC has its own auto-register setting.
admin_settings_app_passkeys_description: Let signed-in users register WebAuthn passkeys (Touch ID, Face ID, hardware keys) and use them to sign in. Your site must be served over HTTPS.
admin_settings_app_password_admins_only_: Make your identity provider the only way in for everyone but admins.
Everyone except admins signs in with OIDC or a passkey, on the web and in the iOS app.
The sign-in page hides the email and password form, and email sign-up is turned off.
If your identity provider is down, admins can still sign in with their password at {#code}{path}{/code}.
Needs OIDC set up and running, and a password on your own account. If OIDC is turned off, password sign-in comes back for everyone.
Set up OIDC and restart the server before limiting password sign-in to admins.
Your account has no password. Turn this on from an admin account that has one, so it can still sign in at {path} if OIDC stops working.
admin_settings_app_sentry_description: Send unhandled errors to a Sentry-compatible service you choose (sentry.io, GlitchTip, or any compatible host), set with {#code}SENTRY_DSN{/code}. Errors only go to that service. See the {#link}Observability docs{/link} for what gets sent.
admin_settings_app_sentry_env_missing: Set {#code}SENTRY_DSN{/code} in your deployment's environment to turn this on.
admin_settings_app_metrics_description: Serve Prometheus metrics at {#code}/api/metrics{/code}, protected by the bearer token in {#code}METRICS_TOKEN{/code}. While this is off, the endpoint returns 404 so it doesn't reveal that it exists. See the {#link}Observability docs{/link} for the list of metrics and an example scrape config.
admin_settings_app_metrics_env_missing: Set {#code}METRICS_TOKEN{/code} in your deployment's environment to turn this on. You can generate a token with {#code}openssl rand -hex 32{/code}.
admin_settings_app_mirror_images_label: Mirror External Images to Storage on Save
admin_settings_app_mirror_images_descrip: When an item is saved, download any external image and copy it into your storage bucket. If the download fails, the item keeps the original URL. Requires storage to be configured. Existing items aren't updated.
admin_settings_app_title_description: Shown in the browser tab, sidebar, and PWA install prompts
admin_settings_holidays_recipient_help: Leave as Everyone for shared holidays like Easter. Pick a person for a one-off like a graduation. Only people who can see that person's lists will see it.
admin_settings_holidays_disabled: Holiday lists are disabled for this deployment. Turn on {#strong}Enable Holiday Lists{/strong} above to manage custom holidays.
admin_settings_holidays_empty: No custom holidays yet. Add one so users can create holiday lists.

match.countPlural=one: Deleted. Converted {count} list(s) to the default type.
match.countPlural=*: Deleted. Converted {count} list(s) to the default type.

match.countPlural=one: {count} list references this holiday. They will be converted to the default list type. Claims will be preserved.
match.countPlural=*: {count} lists reference this holiday. They will be converted to the default list type. Claims will be preserved.

admin_settings_holidays_delete_unreferen: No lists reference this holiday. Safe to delete.
admin_settings_holidays_catalog_dialog_d: Curated gift-giving holidays for the supported countries.
admin_settings_holidays_custom_dialog_de: Define a holiday with a fixed date. Annual recurrence is the default.
admin_settings_email_api_key_description: Used to send all transactional email. Starts with re_ on the Resend dashboard.
admin_settings_email_addresses_descripti: Controls the visible sender and optional BCC recipient on every email.
admin_settings_email_from_email_descript: The address emails are sent from. Must be on a verified Resend domain.
admin_settings_email_from_name_descripti: Optional display name shown before the address.
admin_settings_email_bcc_description: Optional. Every outgoing email is blind-copied here. Useful for archiving or test inboxes.
admin_settings_env_locked_hint: Set by environment variable. Unset the env var to edit here.
admin_settings_email_test_description: Pre-filled with the BCC address (or the From address if no BCC is set). Edit the recipient to send to any address.
admin_settings_email_test_recipient_desc: Defaults to your BCC address, or the From address if no BCC is set.
admin_settings_email_test_template_descr: Pick which transactional email to render with sample data.
admin_settings_sentry_test_sent: Test error sent. It should show up in Sentry as SentryTestError within a minute.
admin_settings_barcode_enabled_descripti: When off, {#code}POST /api/mobile/v1/products/by-barcode{/code} returns 503 and the iOS app treats the feature as unavailable.
admin_settings_barcode_provider_descript: Which provider fires first on a cache miss.
admin_settings_barcode_go_upc_key_descri: Bearer token sent on every Go-UPC request. Stored encrypted at rest.
admin_settings_barcode_go_upc_key_missin: No key set. Lookups will return 503 until you add one.
admin_settings_barcode_cache_ttl_descrip: Cached results older than this are refreshed on the next lookup. Set to 0 to turn off caching.
admin_settings_barcode_tester_descriptio: Run a single provider against a barcode. This skips the cache and the fallback providers, so you can check each provider's setup on its own.
admin_settings_barcode_lookups_detail_de: The saved record from the barcode_lookup_history table.
admin_settings_mobile_redirect_uris_desc: One URI per line. Passkey and OIDC sign-in from the iOS app both need this. Leave it empty to turn both off on mobile. The iOS app uses {#code}wishlists://oauth{/code} by default. Only remove this entry if you're running a forked build with a different URL scheme.
admin_settings_oidc_saved: OIDC settings saved. Restart the server to apply.
admin_settings_oidc_enabled_description: Let users sign in with an external OIDC identity provider (Authentik, Authelia, Pocket ID, Keycloak, Google, etc).
admin_settings_oidc_issuer_hint: The base URL for discovery. The app loads /.well-known/openid-configuration from here.
admin_settings_oidc_logout_hint: Optional. When someone logs out here, they're also signed out of the identity provider.
admin_settings_oidc_client_secret_hint_s: A secret is stored. Type a new value to replace it, or leave it empty to keep the current one.
admin_settings_oidc_client_secret_hint_m: Type the client secret your IdP issued for this app.
admin_settings_oidc_scopes_hint: Space-separated. Leave empty to use the default ("openid email profile").
admin_settings_oidc_button_text_hint: Falls back to "Sign in with OpenID" when blank.
admin_settings_oidc_link_by_email_descri: When a returning user's IdP-provided email matches a local account, link the two instead of creating a duplicate.
admin_settings_oidc_auto_register_descri: Create a new local account for any unknown email returned by the IdP.
admin_settings_oidc_restart_description: OIDC providers are loaded on boot. Save and restart the server to apply changes.
admin_settings_mcp_connect_description: Users add this deployment to Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, or any MCP client by pasting the server URL. The client registers itself, the user signs in and approves it, and the assistant acts as that user. {#link}Read the guide{/link}.
admin_settings_mcp_connect_add_to_claude: Opens Claude with this deployment's name and server URL filled in. Users get the same button under Settings, Connected Apps; copy the link to send it to someone.
admin_settings_mcp_connect_discovery_des: Both documents must be reachable at the origin for clients to find the sign-in endpoints. They go dark when the MCP server is turned off.
admin_settings_mcp_grants_empty: No active connections. Grants appear here once a user approves an AI client.
admin_settings_mcp_grants_filter_placeho: Filter by user name or email
admin_settings_mcp_clients_empty: No AI clients have registered yet. They appear here the first time someone connects one.
admin_settings_cron_runs_empty: No cron runs match the current filters.
admin_settings_cron_tz_banner_title: Daily Emails Run Late at Night in {timeZone}
admin_settings_cron_tz_banner_intro: These jobs use the date in {timeZone}, so their default schedule sends each day's emails late that night:
admin_settings_cron_tz_banner_fix: Move them to a morning time in {timeZone} in your scheduler ({#code}vercel.json{/code}, {#code}render.yaml{/code}, or the cron sidecar). If your scheduler already runs them at a better time, you can ignore this.
admin_settings_cron_vercel_banner_body: This deployment is on Vercel, where cron schedules are read from {#code}vercel.json{/code} at deploy time and cannot be edited from the dashboard. To change a schedule, update the file and redeploy. The Hobby plan only supports daily schedules, while Pro allows any cron expression. Job settings like concurrency, users per run, and retention periods on the General, AI, and Scraping pages still apply and can be changed at any time. The "Run now" button below always works and is the easiest way to check that each route is healthy.
admin_settings_import_enabled_descriptio: Turns bulk import on the list edit page on or off. While it's off, bulk import requests are rejected and the scrape queue job exits without picking up any work.
admin_settings_import_users_per_run_hint: How many different users one run of the scrape queue job handles before leaving the rest for the next run.
admin_settings_import_concurrency_hint: The most jobs that run at once for a single user in one run. This is also how many jobs are picked up for each user per run.
admin_settings_import_max_attempts_hint: How many times a job is tried before it's marked as failed. Failed jobs are kept so you can look into them.
admin_cron_job_auto_archive_description: Reveals claimed gifts once their birthday, Christmas, or holiday reveal date has passed, then emails each list owner to tell them who gave what.
admin_cron_job_birthday_emails_descripti: Sends birthday greetings on the day and reminders ahead of upcoming events, and cleans up claims left on deleted items.
admin_cron_job_cleanup_verification_desc: Deletes expired sign-in verification tokens and clears out old job run history.
admin_cron_job_intelligence_recommendati: Runs the analyzers for each user and saves the recommendations they produce, along with a record of each run.
admin_cron_job_item_scrape_queue_descrip: Works through items that are waiting to have their product details fetched.
admin_mcp_connect_snippet_claude_ai_desc: Use the Add to Claude button above, or go to Settings, Connectors, Add custom connector and paste the server URL.
admin_mcp_connect_snippet_claude_code_de: Then run /mcp inside Claude Code to sign in.
admin_mcp_connect_snippet_json_url_title: Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, and other URL-based clients
admin_mcp_connect_snippet_json_url_descr: Add this to the client’s MCP configuration.
admin_mcp_connect_snippet_mcp_remote_des: Bridge through mcp-remote, which handles the OAuth sign-in in your browser.
admin_ai_feature_never_nothing_about_peo: Anything about your users, their lists, or their gifts
admin_ai_feature_scrape_provider_descrip: Reads a product page with the AI model when it is one of the configured scrape providers.
admin_ai_feature_scrape_provider_sent_pa: The product page URL being added
The text and markup of that page, with scripts and styles removed (up to 32 KB)
admin_ai_feature_scrape_provider_sent_we: With Web Fetch turned on for the AI scraper: the AI provider’s own servers request that URL, so the store sees a visit from the provider
admin_ai_feature_clean_title_description: A small pass after a scrape that strips retailer noise from the title.
admin_ai_feature_photo_extract_descripti: Fills in a new item from a photo the user uploads, on the web or in the iOS app.
admin_ai_feature_photo_extract_sent_barc: The barcode number, when the photo follows a scan in the iOS app that found nothing
admin_ai_feature_barcode_identify_descri: After a barcode scan finds a product, turns the raw title from the barcode provider into a clean one and moves the size and color into the item notes. Runs once per barcode; the result is cached with the lookup.
admin_ai_feature_barcode_identify_sent_p: The product title and brand the barcode provider returned
admin_ai_feature_paste_to_items_descript: An import option that turns pasted text (a notes-app list, a forwarded message) into items. The user reviews the result before anything is added.
admin_ai_feature_paste_to_items_sent_pas: The text the user pasted (up to 8,000 characters)
admin_ai_feature_thank_you_draft_descrip: A “Draft a Thank-You” button on the Received page. It writes a short note the user can edit, copy, or open in their own email app. Nothing is sent to anyone by the app.
admin_ai_feature_thank_you_draft_sent_wr: The first name of the user writing the note
admin_ai_feature_thank_you_draft_sent_gi: The first names of the people who gave the gifts
The titles of the gifts, which have already been revealed to that user
admin_ai_feature_thank_you_draft_sent_de: The name of the pet or baby, when the gifts were for a dependent
admin_ai_feature_thank_you_draft_never_c: What anything cost, and gift notes
admin_ai_feature_thank_you_draft_never_u: Gifts that have not been revealed yet
admin_ai_feature_gift_suggestions_descri: Adds a Need Ideas? button to other people’s lists. It asks for a budget, then shows new gift ideas based on that person’s lists, each of which can be saved to the user’s private Gift Ideas or added to the list as an off-list gift. The AI runs only when a user asks, and never for a child account. The last set of ideas is kept for the user who asked, and nobody else, so reopening shows it without asking the AI again. Off removes the button.
admin_ai_feature_gift_suggestions_sent_r: The first name of the person the gift is for
admin_ai_feature_gift_suggestions_sent_v: Titles, prices, priorities, and categories of the items on that person’s lists that the user asking can already see
admin_ai_feature_gift_suggestions_sent_c: For each of those items, whether it is already claimed (yes or no only)
admin_ai_feature_gift_suggestions_sent_o: The asking user’s own private gift ideas for that person, and the titles of gifts they already gave them
The occasion, taken from the type of list being viewed (a Christmas list, a birthday list, a holiday list)
admin_ai_feature_gift_suggestions_sent_b: The budget, when the user gives one
admin_ai_feature_gift_suggestions_sent_r: Titles of gifts that person received in the last two years on lists the user can see, with the month they were revealed
Titles of items that person removed after nobody gave them, or marked unavailable
admin_ai_feature_gift_suggestions_sent_a: Titles any gifter marked as something that person already has
admin_ai_feature_gift_suggestions_sent_n: Titles the asking user marked as not for them
admin_ai_feature_gift_suggestions_never_: Who claimed anything, who gave any received gift, what anyone paid, and claim notes
Items the asking user cannot see, including anything hidden from a restricted viewer
Other people’s gift ideas, off-list gifts, and comments
Last names, email addresses, and birth dates
admin_ai_feature_intelligence_descriptio: Scheduled suggestions for each user about their own lists: stale items, duplicates, grouping, and set-up nudges. Users see the Suggestions page and can refresh it.
admin_ai_feature_intelligence_sent_items: Titles and notes of the items on the user’s own lists
admin_ai_feature_intelligence_sent_lists: The names and types of those lists, and when each item was last changed
admin_ai_feature_intelligence_sent_state: Whether an item is marked unavailable, and the item groups already on the list
admin_ai_feature_intelligence_never_clai: Claims: who is giving what, costs, and gift notes
admin_ai_feature_intelligence_never_gift: Gift-ideas lists (private notes about other people)
admin_ai_feature_intelligence_never_prof: Profile details: names, email addresses, and birthdays (a name typed into a list name or an item is sent as written)
admin_ai_slot_fast_description: Optional. A smaller, cheaper model for mechanical work that runs often.
admin_ai_slot_vision_description: Optional. A model that reads images, for features that send a photo.
admin_digest_send_email_not_configured: Email is not configured. Set a Resend API key and From Email first.
admin_digest_send_no_recipients: No recipients: there are no admin users and no recipient override is set.
